protocol_deviations: Official upstream evaluator uses two-class macro-F1 within each word, not the legacy positive-class F1; all final scores and training-only cutoff choices are regenerated.
The original 80/20 label-stratified protocol is retained. A second approximately stratified 80/20 protocol groups exact NFKC/case-folded duplicate contexts to prevent their train/test overlap.
Frozen encoders run once without labels and are shared across seeds; repeated retrieval scores reflect split and calibration variation, not independent neural training.
Batch size is reduced to 4 and CPU threads to 2 for local memory constraints; max sequence length, pooling and model revisions are recorded.
Canonical rank depth and K grid remain 100; full-depth ranking and extended cutoff tuning are explicitly separate ablations.
The historical word-ID ablation removes a categorical feature and does not mask surface forms.
Resource costs are measured wall/CPU seconds, sampled resident memory and artifact bytes. Monetary and energy costs are unavailable, not estimated.
All evaluations use the released Swedish development data, not a hidden-test submission. Source-document and near-duplicate leakage are not ruled out by exact-text grouping.
